body: Dash says if Jay-Z ever considers calling him to join a Halftime Show performance, he already knows his answer: “Don’t even call me… I’m not going. ” Dame made it clear he has ZERO interest in being part of the moment if that call ever comes. Would you want to see Dame and Jay-Z reunite onstage one day?
